title: Table status event
description: One status transition emitted by the Rust engine and stored in the Android outbox. unknown must never be folded into available.

confidence.description: Highest model confidence assigned to the table in that frame.

persons_in_region.description: People assigned to the table in that frame.

utcTimestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC. The wire contract forbids local offsets so durations cannot be misread.
